# Tabs

Panels of one view, one shown at a time.

- Status: implemented
- Category: navigation
- Pattern: WAI-ARIA APG “tabs”; HTML `role=tablist / tab / tabpanel`
- Text style: `body` (`.nd-text-body`)

## Anatomy

- **tablist**: A row over the panels, with a line under it.
- **tab**: Text; the selected one has an indicator line.
- **panel**: The content, focusable when it has no focusable content.

## Variants

- `automatic`: Arrow keys select (panels are quick).
- `manual`: Arrow keys move focus, Enter selects (panels load).

## States

- `default`
- `hover`
- `focus-visible`: An inset ring, thicker than 2 px and clear of the indicator line, so focus and selection read as two cues.
- `selected`: An indicator line of 3 px on the divider and primary text; not colour alone.
- `disabled`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Left, Right | Previous or next tab (reversed right to left). |
| Home, End | First or last tab. |
| Tab | From the tab list to the panel. |

## Accessibility

- Role: tablist, tab, tabpanel
- Name: The tab list has a label; each panel is labelled by its tab.
- Tabs that navigate between pages are a navigation, not tabs.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A)
- 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (AA)
- 2.1.1 Keyboard (A)
- 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA)
- 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA)
- 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A)

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div class="nd-tabs">
  <div class="nd-tabs__list" role="tablist" aria-label="Example tabs">
    <button
      type="button"
      class="nd-tabs__tab"
      role="tab"
      id="ex-tab-1"
      aria-selected="true"
      aria-controls="ex-panel-1"
    >
      Overview
    </button>
    <button
      type="button"
      class="nd-tabs__tab"
      role="tab"
      id="ex-tab-2"
      aria-selected="false"
      aria-controls="ex-panel-2"
      tabindex="-1"
    >
      Details
    </button>
  </div>
  <div
    class="nd-tabs__panel"
    role="tabpanel"
    id="ex-panel-1"
    aria-labelledby="ex-tab-1"
    tabindex="0"
  >
    The first panel.
  </div>
  <div
    class="nd-tabs__panel"
    role="tabpanel"
    id="ex-panel-2"
    aria-labelledby="ex-tab-2"
    tabindex="0"
    hidden
  >
    The second panel.
  </div>
</div>
```
